SELECT accounts.id AS accounts_id, accounts.external_ref AS accounts_external_ref, accounts.currency AS accounts_currency, accounts.balance_minor AS accounts_balance_minor, accounts.status AS accounts_status, accounts.created_at AS accounts_created_at, accounts.updated_at AS accounts_updated_at 
FROM accounts 
WHERE accounts.id = $1::UUID

SELECT ledger_entries.id, ledger_entries.transfer_id, ledger_entries.seed_run_id, ledger_entries.account_id, ledger_entries.entry_kind, ledger_entries.signed_amount_minor, ledger_entries.currency, ledger_entries.created_at 
FROM ledger_entries 
WHERE ledger_entries.account_id = $1::UUID ORDER BY ledger_entries.created_at DESC, ledger_entries.id DESC 
 LIMIT $2::INTEGER
